more.title: Reserve Bank governor Lesetja Kganyago sees upside risks to inflation
more.description: Rising global energy prices and food costs continue to pose upside risks to inflation in South Africa, the central bank head said on Thursday, with consumer prices expected to return to the 3% target only in 2028.Speaking in an interview on the sidelines of the International Monetary Fund and World Bank annual meetings in Bangkok, Governor Lesetja Kganyago said inflation is expected to average 4.4% this year before easing to within the central bank’s tolerance band in 2027 and returning to target in 2028.The comments suggest the central bank may need to keep monetary policy tight after it...

more.title: Gayton McKenzie ropes in Cyril Ramaphosa to help with 2028 F1 bid
more.description: With about R2.5-billion now needed to acquire the F1 rights for the 2028 and 2029 seasons, Minister of Sports, Arts and Culture Gayton McKenzie is bringing in heavy artillery in the form of President Cyril Ramaphosa in order to make sure that the motor racing event will return to Mzansi once again.This is after Rwanda landed a landmark 10-year agreement this week to bring the sport back to the African continent, with the Formula 1 African Grand Prix, set to join the calendar in the early 2030s.South Africa, in fact, the entire African continent, last hosted an F1 race in 1993, and this week...
